bullets.text: In Chennai, a road collapse near a metro site swallowed an SUV into a 10-foot sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road, leaving occupants unharmed.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is visiting Chennai with a five-tier security arrangement involving 22,000 police personnel to launch metro expansion projects.
The Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro service is set to start, operating initial services between 4 PM and 9 PM before regular daily schedules.
Minister R. Kumar stated that disaster management preparations to face the northeast monsoon have been successfully completed in Ponneri.
Minister R. Kumar launched 24 battery-operated garbage collection vehicles worth 48 lakh rupees across 21 panchayats in Gummidipoondi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister M. Vijay are scheduled to travel together on the newly launched Chennai metro train.
Dozens of youth were detained in Besant Nagar after demanding Gyanesh Kumar resignation and raising voter list revision concerns.
DMK members staged a protest and dharna in Besant Nagar, successfully pressing police to release the youths detained during the CJP protest.
Motorists faced hardship due to garbage burning along the Ponneri-Minjur highway, highlighting an absence of proper waste management infrastructure.
Water resource department officials intensified cleanup work, including removing thorny weeds and reeds, in the Nandhi River to prevent flood risks.
Reliance Jio is bringing a massive investment to Siruseri near Chennai to establish a 37-megawatt AI Data Centre and technology campus.
Minister R. Kumar distributed job orders to 505 beneficiaries at a private job fair held at a Thiruvallur engineering college.
Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the central government will release a draft consultation paper on artificial intelligence regulations within 30 days.
Farmers threatened an indefinite hunger strike starting October 22 if crop loan waiver demands are not met within the ministerial deadline.
MK Stalin criticized the TVK government for acting as an extension of the BJP and deploying police repression against protesting students.
MP Kanimozhi accused the ruling TVK government of suppressing protests, asserting that its actions in the state mirror those of the BJP.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Chennai to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Porur metro rail service and launch other key development projects.
The Greater Chennai Traffic Police announced commercial and heavy vehicle traffic diversions from 8 AM to 4:30 PM for the Prime Minister's visit.
The Metropolitan Transport Corporation will explore stronger feeder bus services along the Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani corridor of Metro Rail Phase II.
